paragraphs: Get expert mental health treatment in Manhattan Beach to help manage anxiety, depression, and mood disorders. Personalized treatment starts here.

1101 N Sepulveda Blvd #201,
Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Hermosa Beach, Redondo Beach, El Segundo, Hawthorne, Lawndale, Inglewood, Gardena, Playa del Rey
Adults and teens (ages 12-17)
At Neuro Wellness Spa, we’re not just experts in treating your mental health. We’re skilled at helping you navigate your insurance to facilitate treatment, accepting most major insurance and plans.
Let us help you through the maze.

Our compassionate team at Neuro Wellness Spa works with you to determine the specialized mental health treatment that will work best for you. We are here with you every step of the way on your journey.
Our psychiatrists in Manhattan Beach offer personalized mental health evaluations and treatment plans for anxiety, depression, and more. Our services are available both in person and via telehealth.

Our team supports teens facing emotional, behavioral, or academic challenges. Adolescent psychiatric services are designed to help young people build coping skills, manage symptoms, and improve their well-being through personalized treatment.
Talk therapy supports clients dealing with anxiety, depression, and stress. Our licensed therapists use evidence-based approaches like CBT and mindfulness in a peaceful, therapeutic environment.

TMS is an FDA-cleared, non-invasive treatment for depression and other mental health conditions. Our Manhattan Beach location offers TMS therapy, which is ideal for those who haven’t found relief through traditional treatments.

Magnetic e-Resonance Therapy (MeRT) is a non-invasive, personalized treatment that uses brain mapping to guide targeted TMS therapy. Designed for individuals seeking precise, effective mental health care.

You deserve to feel better. At Neuro Wellness Spa, our expertly trained psychiatrists and thoughtfully designed centers provide compassionate, personalized treatment for a wide range of mental health conditions, helping you achieve meaningful, lasting change.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
A pattern of using substances like drugs or alcohol often leads to harmful consequences to physical and mental health, work, or relationships.
ADHD is characterized by difficulty focusing, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that interferes with daily life.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
Between hormonal changes, the psychological adjustment to motherhood, and exhaustion, depression affects approximately 1 in 8 new mothers.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Sometimes stress can come on quickly and feel paralyzing. Panic attacks are sudden, intense, can happen unexpectedly, and affect daily functioning.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Difficulty falling or staying asleep leads not only to fatigue throughout the day, but often irritability and trouble focusing.
There are many causes for trouble with memory, thinking, or decision-making. For those with impairment, it interferes with everyday life or work.
For some, cognitive impairment is a progressive decline over time, and can affect independence and quality of life.
A condition marked by unstable moods, relationships, and self-image, often with intense emotional reactions.
A neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication, social interaction, and behavior patterns in varying degrees.
When pain lasts for months or longer, it takes a toll on a whole person, affecting not just physical functioning but mood as well.
Widespread pain, fatigue, and sleep issues aren’t always easy to explain. Those with fibromyalgia may also be unusually sensitive to touch and stress.
Everyone has bouts of exhaustion, but when it is not easily explained, doesn’t improve with rest, and limits your activities or mental clarity, it is considered chronic fatigue.
Although many people are concerned about health, weight, or appearance, those with eating disorders become fixated on weight loss, body shape, and controlling their food intake.
Neuro Wellness Spa has supported the wellbeing of patients throughout Southern California for over a decade.

Expert clinical care centered around your unique and evolving goals
Deep local support from your care team and peers, today and tomorrow

review.reviewBody: Thank you Neuro Wellness Spa! I highly recommend their treatment for anybody who is interested as this changed the trajectory of my mental health and recovery journey. Their equipment is state of the art and it has been my experience that it is highly effective for treating depression and anxiety. To have this alongside in my recovery has resulted in significant changes that has helped me take on life in a positive way. I no longer go through life weighed down by depression and anxiety thanks to Neuro Wellness's services.

Wow, what an amazing experience with the team at Neuro Wellness Spa. I have been searching for something to help me work through my anxiety and depression for a very long time and I feel like I've finally found a treatment option that actually worked for me! Such a friendly group of staff and doctors who truly care for their patients, which is something quite hard to come by these days in the treatment field. 10/10 would recommend to any of my friends and family looking for an alternative to medication. Give them a try!

mainEntity.name: What psychotherapy and psychiatry services are offered at Neuro Wellness Spa in Manhattan Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Just steps from the Pacific Ocean, our Manhattan Beach location provides a full spectrum of psychotherapy and psychiatry services including in-person and virtual psychiatry, medication management, adolescent psychiatry, addiction psychiatry, psychotherapy (such as talk therapy, CBT, DBT, and addiction counseling), as well as advanced neuromodulation treatments like TMS therapy and MeRT.

mainEntity.name: How do I schedule an appointment at the Manhattan Beach location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call at (877) 847-3984 to speak with our admissions team and schedule an initial appointment. Most patients can be seen within days (including same day or next day in many cases).

mainEntity.name: Who are the psychiatrists and therapists at the Manhattan Beach location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our expert team of therapists is led at our Manhattan Beach location by Dr. Josh Lichtman, D.O., group of experts in treating mental health conditions of all types. Take a look at the faces you’ll find here.

mainEntity.name: How long are therapy and psychiatry sessions at this location?

acceptedAnswer.text: The length of therapy and psychiatry sessions are generally an hour or less. How many sessions are required and the frequency of your sessions will depend on your personalized treatment program.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a referral to see a psychiatrist at Neuro Wellness Spa Manhattan Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — a referral is not needed to see a psychiatrist at Neuro Wellness Spa. Give us a call and we’re happy to discuss your mental health condition and needs with you, regardless of whether you have a referral from your PCP.

mainEntity.name: What insurance providers are accepted the Manhattan Beach location?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept most major insurance at Neuro Wellness Spa. You can find a list of all providers here. Don’t see your insurance provider on our list? Give us a call either way — there may be options to navigate the insurance landscape by working directly with your provider. We’re pros at navigating insurance complexities with our patients.

mainEntity.name: Is there free or convenient parking at the Manhattan Beach clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — dedicated parking is available at our Manhattan Beach location.
